scope: Piano-roll notes on MIDI clips: model, validation, rendering, persistence, pointer and keyboard create/select/delete
environment: Kvant, pinned CI image, docker --network none, Qt offscreen platform
verified_behaviors: Validation refuses length outside 1 tick..16 bars, pitch 128, velocity 0/101, zero length, notes past the clip end, duplicate or unissued IDs, a counter below the IDs, out-of-order notes, a 17th simultaneous note and a 1025th note
Ticks become frames with independent upward rounding: ceil(ticks*30000/tempo) checked at 137 BPM
A clip with notes renders them instead of its pattern; piano-roll-v1 round trips exactly; malformed notes, notes without the feature, reordered notes and notes on audio clips are refused
Converting the template pattern gives four notes (72-tick gates, 70 % velocity) whose float export is sample-identical to the pattern's
Add selects the new note; refusals (outside the clip, pitch, velocity, zero or negative values, the 16-note limit) leave notes and Undo text unchanged
Selection toggles with additive select, survives an unrelated level edit by ID, ignores unknown IDs and clears when another clip is chosen; deleted IDs are not reissued
Delete, Undo, Redo, switching back to the pattern and Undo again restore the same notes and IDs; Save/Open keeps them

QML: a pointer click adds a snapped note, clicking selects, Shift-click extends, Delete removes, the Undo button restores, Escape clears, keyboard fields add an exact note, octave buttons move the view, and the grid and entry row fit a 1000-pixel window
limits: No move/resize/per-note edits (#36), clip length/loop controls (#38) or dense-drawing measurement (#41); offscreen platform with synthetic input.
